description: Unit test class for the DiagnosisValidator, testing validation logic for the Diagnosis model in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: DiagnosisValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for the DiagnosisValidator, containing unit tests to ensure validation rules are enforced properly.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a fresh Diagnosis object and Errors object before each test.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfEncounterIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the encounter field of Diagnosis is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDiagnosisIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the diagnosis field of Diagnosis is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfCertaintyIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the certainty field of Diagnosis is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRankIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the rank field of Diagnosis is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRankIsNonPositive
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the rank field of Diagnosis is less than or equal to zero.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsAreSupplied
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all required fields of Diagnosis are properly set.
